summary.text: Mike Holmstrom, listed by Ballotpedia as Michael Holmstrom Jr., is the Republican incumbent in the Minnesota State Senate, District 29, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.

He is a small business owner who took office on November 18, 2025, after winning a special election, and the Minnesota Senate's member directory lists Michael W. Holmstrom as a Republican representing District 29.

paragraphs.text: Michael Holmstrom Jr.'s career experience includes working as a small business owner, according to Ballotpedia.
He won the August 26, 2025 special Republican primary for Senate District 29 with 73.4 percent of the vote, defeating Bradley Kurtz and Rachel Davis.
He then won the November 4, 2025 special general election with 62.2 percent of the vote, defeating Democrat Louis McNutt, and succeeded Bruce Anderson in the seat.
Holmstrom assumed office on November 18, 2025, and his current term ends in January 2027.
He advanced from the August 11, 2026 Republican primary with 100 percent of the vote and faces Louis McNutt, who won the Democratic primary, in the general election.
Ballotpedia lists an endorsement from the National Federation of Independent Business (NFIB) Minnesota PAC for the 2026 race.
